docs.desc: VSE CORPORATION EX 99.1 - PRESS RELEASE DATED NOVEMBER 4, 2026

reports.title: VSE Corporation Announces Third Quarter 2026 Results

lines: VSE now expects full year 2026 revenue growth of 65% to 66.5%, up from its prior outlook of 61% to 64%.
VSE now expects full year 2026 Adjusted EBITDA margin(3) of 18.9% to 19.1%, up from its prior outlook of 18.7% to 19.0%.
